title: Understanding Polynomial Features
text: Adding polynomial features, like degree $$3$$, means including terms like $${veg}^3$$ in the model. This can help the model capture more complex relationships between the variables.

title: Bias and Variance Trade-off
text: Increasing the complexity of a model, such as adding polynomial features, typically reduces bias because the model can fit the training data more closely. However, it might increase variance as the model becomes more sensitive to fluctuations in the training data.
